question: By whose agency does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine, and to whom is that acknowledgment addressed?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker has come to know something by another's grace.
That thing known is the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
uncertainties: The specific content of the Kaula determination is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
